settings.title: Voice dictation
settings.intro: Hold the shortcut anywhere in the app, speak, then release it: the transcript appears in the field or editor you were using. No button — just a small indicator while it listens.
settings.hotkeyHint: Click, then press your combo. Esc to cancel.
settings.unloadHint: Idle this long → the model leaves VRAM (cold start next time).
settings.liveHint: Text shows up while you talk (periodic re-transcription).

cpp.readyHint: Native binary found — GGUF models (Nemotron) are good to go.
cpp.notInstalledHint: Needed for Nemotron. Drop transcribe-cli (GitHub prebuild) in NR_HOME/bin, or set transcribeCppBin in nr.config.json.

mic.denied: Microphone denied. Allow microphone access to dictate.
mic.fallback: Chosen microphone unavailable — using the default one.
